{{Quote|Red Wing, stay alert&mdash;we could run out of space real fast.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="ROTJ novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Red Wing''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Pilot/Legends|member]] of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] which was also referred to as "Red Wing." The [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] designated Red Wing was [[Executive officer/Legends|second-in-command]] to [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]]<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and was tasked with overseeing the individual units that comprised the [[Fighter wing/Legends|starfighter wing]]. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Guide3" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="SWE" /> Red Wing led Red Squadron [[Starship/Legends|fighter]] units into [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] against the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|starfleet]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Guide3" /> culminating in the destruction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character designated Red Wing was first mentioned in the [[1984]] reference title ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''.<ref name="Guide1">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> "Red Wing" is briefly mentioned in the<ref name="ROTJ novel" /> [[May 12]],<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[1983]] [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ novel" /> the [[original trilogy]] film released on [[May 25]] of the same year,<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes IV–VI, 1977–1983]]''</ref> but it is not clear if the reference is to the pilot or Red Squadron as a whole.<ref name="ROTJ novel" />
